title: BDD slice E: blind run on a Harbor Goods spec
item: A fresh session runs the skill on a Harbor Goods new-format spec and must produce the same kind of tests without help
motivation: A slice of task 1, the BDD skill. Its content depends on what the slice before it shows.
notes: THE SPEC (owner, 2026-11-20: yes to building one new spec from his answers of 2026-11-19): eval/agent-spec/results/ans-1/spec-final/, written by one agent-spec trial the owner runs in his own Claude Code session at high effort, the effort of the baseline trials: /trial agent-spec ans --n 1. A manager builder cannot run a trial, since a trial dispatches its own subagents. This task stays Proposed until that folder exists and Claude in chat has checked that its rules carry the new answers (3 tries for a lookup, not 'without limit'); then it is set Ready on the owner's yes of 2026-11-20. The old candidate, eval/agent-spec/results/switch-base-10/spec-final/, carries the superseded answers and is not used. The builder may read the café example and everything the skill's steps name. The three-trial rebaseline of agent-spec waits until an agent-spec change needs it.
done_means: (1) eval/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/blind-1/ holds the tests the BDD skill (.claude/skills/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/SKILL.md) builds from the spec folder eval/agent-spec/results/ans-1/spec-final/: the folder's data file names that spec folder as its spec, and the spec folder is unchanged. (2) In blind-1/, each command of the skill's verify step (step 11 of its SKILL.md), run there, exits 0. (3) blind-1/features/ holds one feature file for each scenario of the spec's scenarios.md that has World lines, and blind-1/spec_findings.json names every scenario that has none; a test in blind-1/ compares the two sets with scenarios.md and fails when they differ. (4) blind-1/variant_results.json holds one broken variant for each rule a feature file cites, each with one of the skill's outcomes, and the mutation-test command of step 11 reruns them. blind-1/report.md lists every variant not caught by its own rule, with the words of the rule that went unchecked. (5) blind-1/report.md names the spec folder and lists, by the step number of the skill's SKILL.md, every place where the builder did something the skill's text does not say, or the skill's text did not say what to do, with what the builder did there. The reviewer compares blind-1/ with the skill's steps and its café example, and the line fails when the reviewer finds such a place that the report does not list. (6) The task changes no file outside eval/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/blind-1/: neither the skill, its café example, nor any spec.
draft_note: Placeholder written by Claude in chat on 2026-11-17 so the whole path of task 1 shows in the task list. done_means, verified_by and priority are left empty on purpose: Claude writes them from the results of the task this one depends on, and only then is it offered to the owner. Outline in tasks/plans/001.md, section 'Slices B to E'. On 2026-11-20 the manager drafted done_means, verified_by, may_edit, runs_as and summary from task 52's results; the advisor ruled FAILS (tasks/advice/053-1.md): it held only the lines on the verify step and on changing nothing outside the new folder, and failed the line that named the spec and the run's report, so only those two lines are kept. Left open, as it spends money and only the owner knows whether a suite on his superseded answers is worth having (tests 1 and 2): which Harbor Goods spec the run uses, the old eval/agent-spec/results/switch-base-10/spec-final/ or a new one built first from the updated packet. The lines that need the spec named (one feature file per scenario with World lines, a broken variant per rule a feature file cites, a report of where the skill left the builder on its own) are to be written once it is. On 2026-11-20 Claude in chat named the spec on the owner's yes, wrote lines (1), (3), (4) and (5) from the lines the advisor held back in tasks/advice/053-1.md (a reviewer now checks the report's list, and line 4 says 'each rule a feature file cites', as the skill does), rewrote the summary and notes, and set priority.

summary.outcome: Tests for a new Harbor Goods spec, written by a builder that follows only the new BDD skill, pass every check of the skill, and a report lists every place the skill left the builder guessing.
summary.scope: Adds one new folder of tests, built from the Harbor Goods spec written from the owner's answers of 2026-11-19. Changes neither the BDD skill, its café example, nor any spec.
summary.risk: The builder copies café patterns that do not fit an order-cancelling agent, and the tests pass without checking much. Three lines guard against that: one test file per scenario, one broken agent per rule, and a reviewer who checks the list of guesses against the folder.
summary.cost: One builder run; task 52, which wrote the skill, used 684,905 agent tokens. The spec itself is built first by one agent-spec trial the owner runs, 3.42 to 4.06 USD in subagent spend for each baseline trial.

decided_for_you.chosen: RULING: FAILS (advisor job d), tasks/advice/053-1.md: the lines on the verify step and on changing nothing outside the new folder hold; the line naming the spec and the run's report fails, and the lines on feature files and variants hold only once a spec is named. Kept the two lines it held.
decided_for_you.rejected: RULING: HOLDS with all five lines
decided_for_you.why: The failed line carried a choice that spends money inside a pass line, and limited what the builder may read in a way the skill's own steps contradict and no verifier can see.
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner names the spec; then the spec line, the feature-file line and the variant line can be written so a verifier can check them.

decided_for_you.chosen: Manager: the blind run writes its tests to eval/agent-spec-to-pytest-bdd/blind-1/.
decided_for_you.rejected: The skill's default, bdd/ beside the spec folder.
decided_for_you.why: A new folder that nothing reads is cheapest to undo, and bdd/ beside a spec under eval/agent-spec/results/ would land in append-only history.
decided_for_you.would_change: The owner wants the blind run's tests kept beside the spec or in the skill's examples.
